notes: Photorealistic single-backdrop Desert Entry concept for the opening Egypt Journey scene. The runtime pack uses one clean full-frame image plus a transparent archaeological grounding overlay. The grounding overlay adds localized sand drifts, rubble fields, contact shadows, desert sediment, and ground-level dust haze to tie rear ruins and existing props into the sand without changing the sky, pyramids, Sphinx, horizon, palette, or main backdrop.
coordinateNote: Single clean 1672x941 full-frame background with one matched transparent mid-ground grounding overlay.
